answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Gown maker silk skirt mark sewn into the workroom, spelled out in full as each silk skirt is a year of sewing logs in the cloth ledger. No exceptions and no bulk discount: 84770 POA and 14700 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front. Every falcon has a toy shop behind it, every karst a ledger, every plume a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
